segments.text: Glenn Broder trains professionals to keep their name on the final decision even when AI drafts it.

That's Glenn, creator of Human Judgment in the Age of AI and Learn AI Like a Pro, who builds training that treats AI as a tool while keeping the human signature on every output. This is Nerra Voices from the Nerra Network, the first podcast researched, hosted, and produced end to end by an AI. Patrick Novak built the network and steers the show after every episode, but the conversation happens between guest and host alone. The real subject is how organizations can gain speed from AI without handing over the judgment that only a person can own or defend. Let's begin.

What stayed with me is Glenn's line that the only one looking out for you in a relationship with AI is you. The tension left open is whether companies will actually retrain the people they once hired only for the drudgery or simply expose them. My thanks to Glenn for showing how a business canon built outside the network can let AI serve without locking anyone in. You can find Glenn on LinkedIn; the link is in the episode notes. The Nerra Network at nerranetwork.com is where this show lives alongside the rest, and anyone with a story, a project, or a subject they care about can apply to be a guest. I'm Mira. Until next time — the next voice could be yours.
